name: error-429-ratelimited-constructed
constructed: NOT RECORDED. Built from Linear's developer documentation, the page titled "Rate limiting" (read 2026-11-02): a request over a rate limit is answered HTTP 429, its errors array carries the RATELIMITED code in extensions.code, Retry-After gives the number of seconds to wait, and X-RateLimit-Requests-Reset is the time the window resets in UTC epoch milliseconds. The limit (2500) is the one the capture recorded; the remaining count, the reset time and the Retry-After value are illustrative, and the message is ours. No capture provoked a rate limit.
